name: @skill-wiki/mcp-server-core
description: Generic MCP server for any compiled Prime corpus. Exposes one tool — prime_query — that browses atoms, traverses the edge graph, and returns projection-level paths for the agent to Read.

scripts.build:
bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --external '@modelcontextprotocol/*' --external zod && node -e "const f='dist/index.js';const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(s.startsWith('#!'))s=s.replace(/^#![^
]*
/,'#!/usr/bin/env node
');else s='#!/usr/bin/env node
'+s;fs.writeFileSync(f,s);fs.chmodSync(f,0o755);"
